By participating in the same rituals and practices year after year, you may experience a deepening of your understanding and appreciation for the importance of forgiveness, compassion, and kindness towards others. The 40-day Lenten fast, in particular, can be a powerful catalyst for introspection and self-reflection. In summary, the annual cycle of Christmas and Easter, particularly the Lenten fast, can indeed shape your thoughts and feelings about what you owe others.
